name: Plank
common_faults: not bracing the core — passive hanging rather than active tension

substitutions.note: anti-rotation; cable-loaded; more specific trunk stimulus

contraindications: wrist injury — use forearm plank variant
resistance_profile: isometric throughout; difficulty increases with duration or added instability

provenance.notes: Foundational anti-extension exercise. Duration is the primary progression variable at bodyweight. RKC plank (max tension) is more demanding than passive hold.
